query: For my 95‑year‑old male with TIA, among male patients aged 90–100 what were the mean, min, and max diagnostic imaging procedures per admission for 1–3 day versus 4–7 day stays?
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, a.admission_type, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.procedure_id) AS num_procedures, AVG(pr.duration) AS avg_duration, MIN(pr.duration) AS min_duration, MAX(pr.duration) AS max_duration FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN procedures_icd pr ON a.subject_id = pr.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = pr.hadm_id WHERE p.subject_id = 123456 AND p.gender = 'M' AND p.anchor_age = 95 AND p.anchor_year = 2020 AND p.anchor_year_group = '90-100' AND a.admission_type = 'TIA' AND pr.icd_code = '757071' AND (a.dischtime - a.admittime) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '1-3 day' WHEN (a.dischtime - a.admittime) BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN '4-7 day' ELSE 'Other' END AS admission_duration FROM procedures_icd pr JOIN admissions a ON pr.subject_id = a.subject_id AND pr.hadm_id = a.hadm_id JOIN patients p ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id WHERE p.subject_id = 123456 AND p.gender = 'M' AND p.anchor_age = 95 AND p.anchor_year = 2020 AND p.anchor_year_group = '90-100' AND a.admission_type = 'TIA' AND pr.icd_code = '757071' GROUP BY p.gender, p.anchor_age, p.anchor_year, p.anchor_year_group, a.admission_type, admission_duration;
